title: Buffering and temporary storage
summary: Proxy buffering can spill responses to temporary files. Storage capacity, inodes and permissions can therefore affect proxy behavior alongside upstream performance.
checks: Collect capacity and inode headroom on the declared temporary filesystem.
limitations: Filesystem health alone does not prove the proxy used that path.
